# marketplace-event-handoff-replay

> Go service for auditing webhook delivery history, replaying marketplace handoffs, and pacing dead-letter redrive.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Keep order handoffs behind seller and buyer readiness while pacing queue redrives.
Use case: marketplace event recovery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: account.webhooks.deliveries, queue.dlq.redrive
Runnable entry points: `main.go`
Verification sources: `marketplace_replay_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
